title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview
Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 
 
Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform.​ 

​​The Fabric Platform Shell team is dedicated to creating the best SaaS data development environment on the web. Our mission is to build a simple yet fully functional developer environment that attracts and retains developers, ensuring that more solutions are built on Fabric and more consumers use it. We aim to provide a unified and extensible web experience that is easy to understand and navigate, enabling 1st and 3rd party workloads to onboard seamlessly. 

​​We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.

Responsibilities
​​• Designing and building top-notch experiences for the Fabric Platform in browser environments. 
• Working on full stack and backend development to deliver comprehensive experiences. 
• Collaborating closely with UX & UI designers, product managers, program managers, and other engineers throughout the product feature development lifecycle. 
• Demonstrating technical leadership by identifying gaps and writing high-quality code. 
​ 
Embody our culture and values

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications 
​​• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python 
o OR equivalent experience. 
• 6+ years demonstrated expertise in web application development, including JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and at least one popular web frontend framework such as React, Vue, or Angular. 
​ 
Job Requirements: Other & Additional 
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: 
This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
Preferred/Additional Qualifications 
​​• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python 
o OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python 
o OR equivalent experience. 
• A passion for delivering modern, high-performance user experiences in browser environments. 
• Experience in building great developer and user experiences for modern analytics systems. 
• A deep curiosity and willingness to question the status quo. 
• High enthusiasm, integrity, ingenuity, results-orientation, and self-motivation in a fast-paced environment. 
• A love for tackling the next problem, the next experiment, and the next partnership. 
• Committed to work collaboratively, solve problems with teams across the world, and find win/win solutions. 
• A deep passion and empathy for customers, leading to innovative problem-solving. 
​

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

ServiceNow CRM helps companies sell, fulfil, and service customers on one AI-powered platform, spanning Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, and Sales CRM.
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build features across CRM Self-service and customer service workflows, including case and work order management and guided agent experiences.
You will own complex components end to end, working closely with product, design, and adjacent platform teams to ship workflows that agents and customers rely on every day. You will bring strong engineering fundamentals, a bias for quality at scale, and a drive to make customer-facing processes faster and more intelligent with AI.
What you will do:
- Build high-quality, scalable, clean, and reusable applications and integration solutions using ServiceNow platform and related technologies. 
- Partner with the product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, test automation and delivery of high-quality products to our users. 
- Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components with a strong emphasis on performance and reliability. 
- Own critical technical initiatives from planning to deployment, continuously refining and improving existing applications and services. 
- Explore the latest ServiceNow features and evaluate them for adoption 
- Develop proof-of-concept and prototype solutions to validate architectural, design decisions and demonstrate feasibility. 
- Establish and promote best practices around platform development, integrations, and performance optimization. 
- Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by sharing best practices in engineering and quality 
- Mentor and guide engineers, fostering technical excellence and professional growth within the team.

To be successful in this role, you have:
- 5-9 years of software engineering, with a record of technical direction adopted beyond your immediate team. 
- Effective, accountable use of AI coding assistants and agents. 
- Direct, hands-on experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation that verifies them. 
- Production experience with LLM APIs, retrieval-grounded features, agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement — including at least one model or orchestration migration carried through production. 
- Experience in system design, APIs, data modelling, and testing across front-end, server-side, and relational data work with a high quality mindset. 
- Experience in software stack including Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React and demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools and frameworks. 
- Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG, Playwright) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
- On-call and incident-command experience on customer-facing systems, including ownership of the systemic fixes that followed. 
- Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack. 
- Bachelor's degree in CS, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
Good to have: 
- Experience using AI Coding tools such as Claude or Codex. 
- CRM domain knowledge and working experience

Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. title: Senior Software Engineer (Institutional, USDC)
location: Remote - USA, US - Remote Zone 1 (Job Requisitions Only)
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the USDC team within the Institutional Product group, you'll design, build, and scale the systems that safely manage billions of dollars in loans across Portfolio Margin, Trade Finance, Agency Lending, Bilateral Lending, and more. Financing is foundational to the Prime Brokerage business, enabling customers to use leverage on trading positions and generate yield on long holdings. You'll own critical backend services that drive recurring revenue, increase trading activity, and keep institutional assets on platform.

What you'll do:

- Own the design and delivery of new financing products and features, from architecture through production launch, ensuring correctness and safety across high-value lending operations.

- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and frameworks that support loan lifecycle management, risk calculations, and real-time position tracking.

- Drive engineering excellence by improving developer tooling, testing infrastructure, monitoring, and operational reliability across financing systems.

- Partner with Product, Risk, Operations, and other engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, well-scoped technical solutions each quarter.

- Lead technical initiatives that strengthen system resilience, reduce operational risk, and support the team's ability to ship safely at speed.

Required skills and experience:

- 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, with production ownership of services handling high-reliability or financial workloads.

- Proven track record designing, building, and scaling service-oriented architectures in Go, Java, or a comparable backend language.

- Experience building and operating distributed systems where correctness, availability, and data integrity are critical.

- Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical design reviews, and raise the bar on code quality across a team.

- Familiarity with relational data stores, gRPC/Protobuf, and observability tooling in a cloud-native environment.

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Software Engineer , Backend  (5-7 years)
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer with 5 to 7 years of experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will play a critical part in designing and building robust, highly scalable distributed systems. You will collaborate closely with product leadership, mentor junior team members, and take immense ownership of complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
- System Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web-based applications. Create architectural abstractions and technical contracts with a strict adherence to the separation of concerns.

- Problem Solving & High-Level Design: Drive solutions for high-level business and technical problems. Lead functional modeling, module decomposition, and system design initiatives.

- Architectural Evolution: Implement incremental changes to the existing architecture and conduct comprehensive impact analyses.

- Performance Optimization: Profile, tune, and improve performance across large-scale distributed systems.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate business features into technical capabilities. Lead the execution of medium-sized projects and structure workflows into distinct phases to ensure predictable delivery.

- Stakeholder Alignment: Work with broader stakeholders to track the impact of deployed projects and features, proactively iterating on them for continuous improvement.

- Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers, foster a collaborative team culture, and promote engineering excellence.

Required Qualifications
- Education: B.Tech, M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

- Experience: 5 to 7 years of professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of solving problems at scale.

- Programming Expertise: Extensive experience in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C, C++). Exceptional coding skills with the ability to fluently translate design into maintainable, scalable, and unit-tested code.

- Concurrency: Strong hands-on experience with multi-threading and concurrent programming.

- System Design: Deep expertise in Object-Oriented Design (OOD), design patterns, and building intuitive module and class-level interfaces.

- Scale & Data Management: Proven experience building highly scalable business applications, handling complex business flows, and processing massive volumes of data.

- Database Proficiency: Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., MySQL) as well as NoSQL technologies (e.g., HBase, Elasticsearch, Aerospike).

- Engineering Best Practices: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience with the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on a Linux platform.

- Working Environment: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a high-growth, dynamic startup environment with high levels of ownership and commitment.

- Drive & Passion: A strong analytical mindset with a genuine passion for solving complex, real-world technical challenges.

Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

You’ll deliver new product capabilities across our platform, working across the full stack — from database models to UI components — and owning features end-to-end. AI is central to how you’ll work: you’ll use AI-assisted development tools daily to accelerate your output, build AI-powered product experiences for our customers, and help establish the practices that make our team effective in this new operating model.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and improve APIs, microservices, and frontend experiences that power government agencies at scale

 - Own features end-to-end: collaborate with Product and Design to define the problem, build the solution, ship it, and monitor it in production

 - Build AI-powered product features — from intelligent data analysis and agent-driven workflows to AI-assisted user experiences that transform how government teams work

 - Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your workflow to accelerate coding, debugging, and documentation

 - Produce clean, well-documented code and conduct thorough reviews of both human-written and AI-generated code, with a sharp eye for the subtle failure modes each produces

 - Collaborate across the organization to translate business priorities into shipped features that drive customer success




REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Have 12+ years of professional experience building scalable software in an agile environment

 - Have strong experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React or similar) and backend development

 - Are comfortable working across the stack — frontend, backend, data layer — and shipping features end-to-end

 - Have built heavily utilized enterprise SaaS software

 - Actively use AI-assisted development tools and have a feel for when they accelerate you vs. when they lead you astray

 - Have experience building AI-powered product features: agents, AI-driven UX, workflow automation, or retrieval systems (direct ML/model training experience not required)

 - Have built APIs, designed database models (SQL and NoSQL), and worked with event-driven patterns

 - Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where new ideas ship daily, staying closely aligned to customer needs and outcomes

 - Demonstrated experience working directly with customers to improve product experiences

 - A track record of experimenting with new AI tools and bringing effective ones to your team

 - Track record of driving team improvement through mentoring and process innovation

 - Previous work in govtech, fintech, or regulated SaaS environments




OUR STACK

React  ·  TypeScript  ·  Ember.js  ·  Node.js  ·  GraphQL  ·  REST  ·  PostgreSQL  ·  MongoDB  ·  AWS  ·  Azure  ·  Kubernetes  ·  Docker  ·  GitHub




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Senior Software Engineer, App Enablement
description:
SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, APP ENABLEMENT




THE OPPORTUNITY

Hinge Health’s mobile app reaches members through a production system spanning code integration, mobile builds, release candidates, app-store submission, and phased rollout. App Enablement helps mobile engineering teams ship dependable changes and build on a reliable, shared mobile platform. The team owns both the path from code merge through app-store release and the platform capabilities that help product teams build efficiently and consistently.

As a Senior Software Engineer on App Enablement, you’ll contribute across mobile release operations and platform engineering, with your focus shifting between them as team priorities change. You might improve build, CI, release, and rollout systems, then build or maintain shared mobile-platform capabilities such as the mobile-specific API layer that shapes backend data for the app, server-driven UI, navigation, deep links, and reusable media components. We’re looking for engineers with depth in one area who can partner across the other and are willing to learn into adjacent work. You’ll collaborate with engineering, Quality Engineering, release partners, and product teams. This is a hands-on role with broad impact across the mobile organization.




WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH

 - Design, build, and maintain tooling for mobile builds, release candidates, app-store submissions, and phased rollouts.

 - Build and evolve shared mobile-platform capabilities, including the mobile-specific API layer that shapes backend data for the app, server-driven UI, navigation, deep links, and reusable media components, in partnership with product pods.

 - Improve the reliability, speed, and observability of mobile CI and release pipelines; investigate recurring failures and reduce manual toil with durable fixes.

 - Coordinate release readiness, blocker triage, communication, and resolution with the teams responsible for affected changes.

 - Improve dependency management and mobile code-quality practices, including responses to security updates and iOS and Android ecosystem changes.

 - Reduce friction for feature teams with practical developer tools, documentation, and guidance, while respecting Quality Engineering’s ownership of test automation and sign-off.

 - Define and improve release-readiness checks, staged-rollout safeguards, monitoring, and rollback practices so teams can detect and respond to release risk.

 - Measure pipeline and release performance, identify recurring bottlenecks, and use evidence to prioritize improvements and communicate impact.

 - Balance delivery speed, release safety, maintainability, and compliance; mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, and shared operational practices.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Effective communication: You communicate clearly and early, raise risks with context, and help teams make decisions and move work forward.

 - Learn-it-all: You are curious about unfamiliar systems and open to feedback; you use incidents, metrics, and reviews to improve your approach. You thoughtfully evaluate approved AI-assisted tools and validate generated changes with tests and running software.

 - Hustle: You act with urgency and creativity on release and reliability problems while applying sound judgment and preserving release safety.

 - Accountability: You own commitments and outcomes from investigation through rollout and follow-up, communicate gaps promptly, and close the loop.

 - Lead at all levels: You are hands-on and proactive, see gaps, propose practical direction, and help peers improve through reviews and design discussions.




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 - 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience.

 - Experience building and operating production software, including hands-on delivery from investigation through rollout and use of sound testing, debugging, and code-review practices.

 - Experience in mobile application or platform engineering, or mobile build and release systems, with a working understanding of the iOS and Android delivery lifecycle and willingness to contribute across both areas.

 - Experience improving CI/CD or developer tooling through automation, observability, or systematic problem-solving.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience supporting React Native or another cross-platform mobile application alongside native iOS or Android build workflows.

 - Experience designing or maintaining shared mobile-platform capabilities, such as mobile-specific APIs that shape backend data for the app, server-driven UI, navigation, deep links, or reusable media components.

 - Familiarity with mobile build services such as Bitrise or similar tools, source-control automation, app signing, and app-store release management.

 - Experience diagnosing intermittent or recurring mobile CI failures and improving build pipeline reliability or speed.

 - Experience with dependency-update automation, mobile security updates, platform-policy changes, or release-compliance preparation.

 - Experience designing release-readiness checks, staged rollouts, health monitoring, or rollback workflows.

 - Experience measuring pipeline performance and reliability, then using the evidence to prioritize improvements.

 - Experience coordinating releases across mobile engineering, Quality Engineering, product teams, and platform partners.

 - Experience mentoring engineers through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, or shared operational practices.




HINGE HEALTH HYBRID MODEL

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.






ABOUT HINGE HEALTH

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com http://hingehealth.com.




WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT US

 - Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

title: Staff Software Engineer L6
description:
The Staff Software Developer L6 will drive the technical design and execution of our core data platforms and full-stack applications. Benefits

title: Front End Engineer II
description:
Like to develop real-time, distributed, large-scale, and modern front-end applications? Like to craft interfaces that are not just fast and reliable but intuitive, accessible, and a pleasure to use? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that make advertising and its billing frictionless? Familiar with front-end development technologies such as JavaScript, ReactJS, AngularJS, HTML5 and CSS3 and front-end design patterns? Interested in being part of a worldwide Advertising Customer Experience team? Then, the Software Development team that builds Tier-1 customer-facing front-end Advertising Experiences wants you!

Advertising is one of the fastest growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Amazon Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost their product reach and sales through performance and display advertising.

The Ads Billing platform is an enabler for Amazon Advertising's worldwide rapid growth and offers a singular platform to manage all of the advertiser-facing functions like billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and the Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) in real-time while being transparent and auditable from the ground up. As a part of this high-energy, entrepreneurial team you will get an opportunity to innovate on solutions that control the very levers of our advertisers' experience and have the satisfaction of seeing your work impact multiple advertising businesses and bring in multi-million transactions worth 100x in dollar value on a daily basis. This platform owns these mandates for worldwide advertising displayed On or Off Amazon.

The Ads Billing team is looking for a Front-End Engineer to build global, scalable, extensible, and secure front-end applications for Billing, Budgeting, Payments, and Promotions Advertiser Experience (AX). These applications have to seamlessly interact with different downstream ad serving platforms, billing and budgeting systems across a broad variety of advertisement programs with no loss in information, and they build the customer-facing experiences that make billing, budgeting, and payments for advertising frictionless. The platform has to guarantee a latency SLA of milliseconds so that the real-time experience of advertisers is never impacted. Beyond raw performance, these are the surfaces advertisers reach for to understand what they owe, why they owe it, and how to act on it — so the work is as much about clarity, usability, and craft as it is about distributed architecture. To build this platform you will need to be well versed in high-performance and distributed front-end architecture, and care deeply about the experience on the other side of the screen.

Key Technical Challenges:

Distributed and Scalable Front-End Architecture: Looking at advertising's international expansion and business growth plans for next year, we expect this traffic to grow 10X in the near future. Billing and Budgeting front-end systems should scale easily to manage an exponential increase in business and be extensible to support different business needs.

High Availability: These are customer-facing Tier-1 front-end applications. Downtime in Advertiser Experience systems can cause a huge loss in revenue and business opportunity for our advertisers, and is a serious trust buster. A high-availability architecture ensures the system is configured to handle different loads and failures with minimal or no downtime.

Customer Experience and Usability: Billing is where trust is won or lost. Advertisers need to understand complex charges, budgets, and payment states at a glance, across dozens of locales, currencies, and regulatory regimes. The challenge is to turn that complexity into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software — applying proven UI design patterns, meeting Amazon's accessibility bar, and partnering with Product and UX to ship simple, coherent experiences that advertisers find clear, predictable, and easy to act on.

What is Amazon Advertising? 
Amazon Advertising is a set of tools offered to advertisers — sellers, vendors, authors, publishers, and more — to increase the visibility of their products and services on Amazon, using Cost-per-click (CPC) and Cost-per-impression (CPM) programs. At the scale of Amazon it is extremely important for our advertisers to have the right set of controls to create and boost their advertising presence to gain customers and create long-term value.

Key job responsibilities
You own what you and your team creates.

You work with your team to invent, design, and build software that is stable, performant, secure, and accessibility compliant. You work on feature ideas with customers, designers, product managers, stakeholders, and peers.

You increase the speed of implementation of UX features by identifying and mitigating design risks early.

You view your interface creations from the customer’s point of view.

You start from the advertiser's experience and work backwards — turning complex billing, budgeting, and payment flows into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software, so advertisers can understand what they owe and act on it with confidence.

You bring ideas to the table. You spot opportunities to simplify or reimagine an experience, prototype and propose them, and advocate for the approach that best serves our customers in Product and UX debates.

You are proficient in view layout and rendering technologies (e.g., responsiveness, device/browser support, progressive enhancement, interaction fluidity) and know when it is appropriate to make graceful fallbacks.

You understand how to build, package, deploy, and deliver your code and supporting assets (e.g., images, fonts) to the user. You optimize delivery of code and assets to the client (e.g., using CDNs, caching, compression).

You are judicious when introducing dependencies and efficient with resource usage (e.g., application impact on memory and CPU, cache appropriately, respectful of customer’s devices, etc.).

The fast growing Ads Billing team today has members across Bangalore, Seattle, and New York, and like the advertising business is truly global in spirit!

- 1+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. 

About the role

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer in Bengaluru to design, build and run production services end to end. You'll take a problem from a loose description to a shipped, reliable system — and you'll be trusted to do it without step-by-step direction.
Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with your Engineering Manager, Product, and Customer Support, and help raise the technical bar of the team around you.
What you'll own in your first year
- Own: Own your services end to end with speed, quality, depth and long-term vision — design, build, release, monitor, fix.
- Hard problems. Take ambiguous problems, break them down, and drive them to a shipped solution with little hand-holding.
- Design. Write and defend design docs for your area, and make the tradeoffs explicit.
- Quality. Treat testing, observability and on-call as part of the work, so customers don't find our bugs.
- Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and use support issues and usage data to decide what to fix next.
- Raising the bar. Review code thoughtfully, mentor newer engineers, and help interview candidates.

What you must bring

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

- Experience: 3–6 years building production software. More is welcome if the role and level are the right fit for you. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
- You've shipped systems that run in production. Not just features handed off — services you built, released and supported when they broke.
- You are exceptional at problem solving. You take ambiguous, system-level problems with more than one valid answer, reason from first principles, weigh the tradeoffs, and land on a solution that's simple and correct.
- You work with minimal handholding. You've taken loosely defined work from start to finish without needing someone to break it down for you.
- Passion for making System NFRs: You never lose sight of System NFRs to create highly available and extensible systems which are scalable and low on maintenance.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

Technical background

You've built and run production systems with a modern stack, such as:
- Cloud: AWS — you've designed, deployed and operated services on it, not just consumed them.
- Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
- Databases, in depth: data modeling, query and index optimization, and scaling (replication, partitioning, caching). You can walk us through a schema you designed and a slow query or bottleneck you fixed, with the before and after.
- Fundamentals: API design, concurrency, caching, and how distributed systems fail.
Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

What sets great candidates apart
- Impact you can explain. You can name a result, the baseline it moved from, and what you did to move it.
- One hard problem, told in detail. A scale, performance or debugging story where you understood the internals, not just the API.
- Ownership over time. A system you've owned across versions and kept improving, not one you built and left.
- Framework mindset: You spot repeated custom implementations and turn them into reusable frameworks or libraries others build on.
- Product sense. You've pushed back on a requirement, simplified scope, or suggested a better solution for the user.
- Lifting others. Code reviews, docs or mentoring that made the people around you faster.
 
What we look for in everyone we hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.
- Customer obsession. You know who uses what you build and what changed for them. You treat support issues and on-call as signal, not chores.
- Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. You'll choose the boring solution if it ships sooner.
- Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, flag problems early, and say what didn't work.
- Independence. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You find the problem worth solving and get it done with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
- Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project you kept alive, a technology you went deep on, things you taught others.
- Depth. At least one system or domain you could talk about for an hour, down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Years in a role aren't depth; complexity handled is.
Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. This is an AI-first team in two senses: we ship AI into the product, and we build software with AI — agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment.

We are looking for Senior Software Engineers to build Splash's next generation of AI features across the full stack — Java and Spring Boot services on AWS that orchestrate LLM calls, retrieval, and tool use, and React and Next.js front ends that turn them into experiences users trust. You have taken LLM-powered functionality to production, not just prototypes, and you are comfortable owning a feature from the API contract and model integration through to the interface. You may lean towards the backend or the front end, but you are credible across both and willing to work wherever the feature needs you. You take ownership from design to deployment, thrive in ambiguity, hold yourself to a high standard, and already build with agentic coding tools as a matter of course — and you are rigorous about verifying what they produce. You will work alongside a Lead and Principal Engineer on the team and partner closely with Product, Design, and the wider Splash engineering organisation.

In This Role, You Will:

Build and ship AI features for Splash
- Design and deliver AI features end to end: Java and Spring Boot microservices on AWS that orchestrate LLM calls, retrieval, tool use, and structured generation; GraphQL and REST contracts; and React and Next.js front ends with TypeScript — conversational and agentic interfaces, streaming responses, human-in-the-loop review flows, and generative tools embedded in existing Splash workflows.
- Build the AI platform plumbing that features depend on: prompt and model versioning, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, caching, cost and latency controls, and observability for LLM calls.
- Work with relational and NoSQL data stores, vector search, and event-driven messaging (e.g. SQS, SNS, Kafka) to build reliable, scalable data flows for AI workloads.
- Make AI experiences trustworthy and usable: handle latency, uncertainty, errors, and model failure modes gracefully in the interface; design for accessibility; and instrument what you ship so we can measure how users actually use it.
- Own features end to end — from design and development through deployment, monitoring, and production support — with minimal oversight.

Own quality and non-functional requirements
- Ensure what you ship meets Splash's bar for security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance, and responsible-AI expectations, including evaluation of model output quality before and after release and how that output is presented and controlled in the UI.
- Write meaningful unit, component, integration, and end-to-end tests and evals; participate actively in design and code review; and raise the quality of the code base you touch.

Work AI-natively
- Work AI-natively every day: write specs that an agent such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents can execute, delegate well-bounded work to it, and review and correct its output with the same rigour you would apply to a colleague's pull request.
- Know where AI tooling fails. Verify generated code, tests, and documentation for correctness, security, and maintainability before it ships, and share what you learn about effective prompting, context, and verification with the team.

Collaborate across geographies
- Partner closely with Product and Design on problem framing, prototypes, and iteration, and with Splash engineers in Bangalore, North America, and Spain on shared services, components, and design systems.
- Write design notes, decisions, and status updates that colleagues in other time zones can act on without a meeting, and share on-call and production support for the services and applications your team owns.

Here's What You Need:

Primary Skills:

- 5+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production web applications across the stack.
- Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot for building distributed microservices — service decomposition, inter-service communication (REST and messaging), and resilience patterns.
- Strong expertise in React and Next.js with TypeScript — component architecture, state and data-fetching patterns, server-side rendering, performance optimisation, and accessibility. We expect depth on at least one side of the stack and genuine working proficiency on the other.
- Hands-on experience building and operating services on AWS (e.g. ECS/EKS or Lambda, SQS/SNS, RDS or DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront) and with cloud-native architectures.
- Experience designing and consuming GraphQL and REST APIs, and with relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design and query performance.
- Experience building AI-driven user experiences: streaming LLM output, conversational or agentic UI patterns, and handling latency and uncertainty in the interface.
- Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development — you use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts.
- Experience shipping AI-driven functionality to production — LLM-powered features such as retrieval-augmented generation, agents, or structured generation — and a working understanding of evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, software design principles, distributed systems, and a track record of owning non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, performance) for production systems.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and running services you built in production.
- Clear written and verbal communication in English, and the ability to work as a peer with engineering, product, and design colleagues in other regions and time zones.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with vector databases and retrieval pipelines (e.g. OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone) and with embedding and chunking strategies.
- Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks and protocols (e.g. Spring AI, LangChain4j, Vercel AI SDK, Model Context Protocol) and with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
- Experience with design systems and component libraries at scale, and with product analytics and experimentation tooling.
- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or Terraform, and with observability tooling such as Datadog (including RUM and front-end performance monitoring).
- Experience building evaluation frameworks or observability for LLM features in production (e.g. offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge, tracing with Datadog or LangSmith).
- Experience with GraphQL APIs, including schema design and federation.
- Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows.
- Experience joining a newly formed team and helping to establish its norms, tooling, and ways of working.

title: Senior Engineer (frontend)
description:

You will work closely with product managers and designers and proactively share your own knowledge of frontend technologies and practices with the wider team. We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality.

Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office.

Required Skills
- 7+ years of professional experience in software development for scalable, web-based applications.
- Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.
Core languages & frameworks
- Strong TypeScript (strict) and modern JavaScript (ES Modules, async).
- Deep React experience (hooks, composition, performance); React 19 / React Compiler a plus.

Build & tooling

State & data

Styling & design systems

Accessibility & i18n

Testing & quality

AI Tooling

Soft skills
- Strong problem-solving abilities and an eagerness to learn.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team.
- High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

Nice to Have
- Web Crypto / AES-GCM application-level encryption and client-side key management.
- Lexical (or ProseMirror/Slate) rich-text/formula editors; grammar parsing (ohm-js).
- Dependency-graph / DAG modeling (graphlib/graphology).
- CRDT / operational-transform real-time collaboration.
- Storybook and visual regression testing.
- New Relic browser RUM, Pendo, and web-vitals (INP/FPS) instrumentation.
- Experience meeting enforced performance budgets and SLOs in CI.
- Domain knowledge in finance, ERP, FP&A, budgeting, or spreadsheet-like applications.

 Key Responsibilities
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain new features for our SaaS platform, applying a broad knowledge of frontend principles and practices to difficult assignments.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, and act as a source of technical guidance in code reviews and best-practice discussions.

- Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified in the production environment.
- Improve the performance, scalability, and security of the platform.

title: Staff Software Engineer- BE
description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead technical direction across a major feature area or set of related systems at OneTrust. Staff Engineers determine their own approach on complex, often ambiguous assignments, and their technical judgment is trusted well beyond their immediate team.

Your Mission

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Lead design and architecture for major features or components, ensuring alignment with the broader system architecture. 
- Determine approach and methods independently on complex, ambiguous assignments without an established playbook. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with other engineering teams, Product, and UX to shape solutions before implementation begins. 
- Build working relationships and technical credibility beyond your immediate team. 

Quality & Standards

- Establish and champion engineering best practices adopted by your team and beyond. 

Mentorship

- Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, helping them grow their technical judgment and scope of ownership. 

You Are

Someone who determines methods and approach independently on new, complex assignments, and who is sought out by other engineers for technical guidance beyond your own team. You think in terms of systems and tradeoffs, not just individual tickets.

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 
- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience 
- Demonstrated track record leading technical initiatives that span multiple engineers or systems 
- Deep expertise in frontend and/or backend technologies relevant to OneTrust's platform, including cloud architecture experience 
- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Windsurf, or similar) in a professional setting, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to accelerate and elevate day-to-day engineering work. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. About the role:

Location: Bengaluru, India | Team: Splash | Reports to: Software Engineering Manager, Splash

Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. The team works as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom we plan, design, and ship. This is an AI-first team in two senses: we ship AI into the product, and we build software with AI — agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment.

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of AI features across the Splash stack — Java and Spring Boot services on AWS and React and Next.js front ends — and to set the engineering bar for a newly formed team. You have 8+ years of hands-on experience, you have taken LLM-powered functionality to production and owned its quality, and you can zoom out to shape architecture and zoom in to deliver production-ready code. You will lead design for multi-engineer work, mentor the Senior Engineers on the team, and partner with the Engineering Manager and Principal Engineer on how the team works — including how agentic coding tools and spec-driven development are used, reviewed, and measured. You thrive in ambiguity, take end-to-end ownership, and hold the people around you to a high standard without lowering your own.

In This Role, You Will:

Lead delivery of AI features for Splash
- Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of full-stack AI features — from problem framing with Product and Design through architecture, implementation, evaluation, release, and operation — for a product area owned by the team.
- Drive architectural decisions across the team's Java and Spring Boot microservices, event-driven integrations on AWS, GraphQL APIs, and React and Next.js front ends, so that they form a cohesive, maintainable platform for AI features.
- Design the AI components of features — retrieval, agent and tool-use patterns, structured generation, prompt and model lifecycle — with explicit attention to evaluation, cost, latency, and failure modes.
- Break ambiguous requirements into clear, sequenced engineering plans; coordinate dependencies with Splash teams in other regions; and communicate progress and trade-offs to stakeholders honestly.
Set the engineering bar
- Be a quality gate for the team: review designs, AI-generated code, tests, and evaluations for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability, and teach the Senior Engineers to do the same.
- Own non-functional requirements — security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance — and responsible-AI expectations for what the team ships.
- Lead incident response and post-incident learning for the team's services, and drive the improvements that come out of it.
Lead the AI-native way of working
- Together with the Engineering Manager, define how the team works with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development: what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, and what must be verified by a human.
- Model that way of working in your own code and reviews, keep the team's tooling and practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash organisation.
Grow people
- Mentor and technically guide engineers on the team through pairing, design reviews, and direct, timely feedback, elevating code quality and design thinking.
- Contribute to hiring: interview candidates, help calibrate the bar, and help new engineers become productive quickly.

Here's What You Need:

Primary Skills:
- 8+ years of professional software development experience, including leading the design and delivery of significant features or systems with other engineers.
- Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot for distributed microservices, and strong experience with React or Next.js with TypeScript — you are credible and hands-on across the full stack.
- Experience designing and operating event-driven microservices on AWS (e.g. ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, RDS or DynamoDB) and with GraphQL and REST API design.
- Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design and performance tuning.
- Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development — you use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts.
- Experience taking AI-driven functionality to production and owning its quality — LLM-powered features such as retrieval, agents, or structured generation — including evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes.
- Strong engineering judgment: you can evaluate a design or a change for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability without having written it yourself, and you have a track record of owning non-functional requirements for production systems.
- Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical work across a team.
- Clear written and verbal communication in English, and the ability to work as a peer with engineering, product, and design colleagues in other regions and time zones.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Skills:
- Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks and protocols (e.g. Spring AI, LangChain4j, Vercel AI SDK, Model Context Protocol) and with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
- Experience with vector search and retrieval pipelines (e.g. OpenSearch, pgvector) in production.
- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or Terraform, and with observability tooling such as Datadog.
- Experience building evaluation frameworks or observability for LLM features in production (e.g. offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge, tracing with Datadog or LangSmith).
- Experience with GraphQL APIs, including schema design and federation.
- Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows.

As a React Native Software Development Engineer, you’ll be working in an agile team of industry leading engineers upon Tesco’s customer facing mobile application. Working with Product Managers, you will be responsible for the future direction of the products that we build, solving problems and developing new features through quality, scalable, performant and maintainable technical solutions. The solutions that you will be responsible for will have a global reach, impacting millions of customers.

You’ll enjoy working as part of a team and be a keen problem solver. Comfortable with modern engineering practices and mobile development tooling and technologies you’ll use innovation to improve the customer experience and efficiency of engineering teams.

Qualifications
and relevant experience for this job

Experience in architecting complex mobile applications
Extensive experience working on commercial software development in React Native

Firm understanding of software development principles, capabilities, and limitations of mobile platforms

A strong team player with the ability to influence and lead stakeholders when necessary
Demonstrable ability to self-manage, be proactive, take ownership, build relationships, and drive solutions through from inception to production

You will need
What will you do?
You will be working on the Tesco UK mobile application to implement the capabilities to improve and personalize customer experience and ease of use in the store. In this team we use the latest technologies, working with a GraphQL backend (maintained by another team). This squad of 7 will have both Android and iOS developers and you will work closely with our other native development and platform teams to deliver a high-quality product.
We love to work with smart people who have a strong sense of ownership and strong engineering mindset.

You outline paths from prototype to product.
You are a technical leader for your team. You contribute to the professional development of colleagues, improving their technical knowledge and the engineering practices on your team.

Whats in it for you?

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
 
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
 
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits. 
 
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
 
Salary - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
 
Leave & Time-off - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
 
Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
 
Health is Wealth - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
 
Mental Wellbeing - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents. 
 
Financial Wellbeing - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request. 
 
Save As You Earn (SAYE) - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan. 
 
Physical Wellbeing - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 

About Us
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
 
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
 
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

title: DISTINGUISHED, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
description:
About Team

We are team of highly skilled engineers owning Data Foundations and Avoid pillar in Customer Care Tech from Bengaluru, India. Team is rightly balanced delivering critical business initiatives at the same time very focused on innovation, engineering and operational excellence. This team is responsible for building an enterprise-scale, AI-powered platform that transforms customer and operational signals into actionable insights to identify defects and improve customer experience. This work enables proactive issue resolution, improved operational efficiency, and progress toward Walmart’s vision of delivering Perfect Orders.

This is not just another engineering job. This is your opportunity to:

Lead and contribute in the latest cutting edge technology – Agentic Solutions

Set the blueprint for scalable, resilient, and high-performing platforms.

Influence technical strategy across domains that power the core of Walmart’s digital business.

Mentor, elevate, and inspire principal engineers, architects, and engineering managers globally.

Champion a culture of innovation, inclusion, and technical excellence at scale.

Ready to architect the future? Apply today and join us on our mission to reimagine global retail, one domain at a time.

What You'll Do

As a Distinguished Engineer in the Agentic Care Tech domain, you’ll operate at the intersection of scale, complexity, and impact. You’ll drive the technology vision and architecture for our Agentic Care Tech teams, including Self Serve, Agent Experience, Contact Centre as a Platform, and Agentic Insight Harness—spanning frontend and backend and Agentic AI capabilties. Your leadership will enable world-class engineering solutions for hundreds of millions of customers across multiple countries and markets.

Agentic AI Architecture: Define and drive the enterprise Agentic AI architecture, designing scalable, secure, and resilient multi-agent systems that enable autonomous reasoning, orchestration, and execution across complex business workflows.

Architect for Scale: Design and evolve the technical architecture for highly scalable microservices and modern frontend applications (React, Node.js, GraphQL, Java, Spring Boot, NoSQL, Kafka, Azure) and handling data at scale

Drive Cross-Domain Vision: Set and align architectural direction across Cart, Checkout, Promotions, Order Amends, and Platform, ensuring seamless integration and a unified customer experience.

Lead by Influence: Guide and mentor principal engineers, architects, and managers. Be a trusted advisor, shaping best practices, technical direction, and major design decisions.

Foster Engineering Excellence: Build frameworks, standards, and tools that raise the bar for code quality, reliability, and operational excellence across all teams.

Champion Innovation: Lead technical explorations, evaluate emerging technologies, and incubate solutions that future-proof our business.

Cultivate a Culture of Collaboration: Partner closely with product, UX, program management, and global engineering teams. Build an environment of psychological safety, learning, and respect for diverse perspectives.

Ensure Resilience and Security: Embed security, performance, and fault-tolerance into every layer of the stack—from the cloud to the customer’s screen.

Deliver Business Impact: Own and deliver solutions that move critical business metrics, unlock growth, and create best-in-class digital retail experiences for millions.

What You'll Bring

Proven Technical Mastery: 16+ years of experience building and scaling complex systems across both frontend and backend. Deep expertise in microservices, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and modern web frameworks.

Strategic Vision: Demonstrated ability to define and execute cross-domain technical strategy in large, matrixed organizations.

Inspiring Leadership: Track record of mentoring senior engineers, leading design forums, and driving engineering culture at scale.

Architectural Depth: Mastery of technologies including Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, React, GraphQL, NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB), Kafka, and Azure Cloud.

Holistic Mindset: Strong design sensibility and attention to detail; passion for user experience, operational excellence, and business outcomes.

Inclusive Collaboration: Ability to bring together diverse perspectives, foster psychological safety, and build high-performing global teams.

Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executive audiences, architects, and engineering teams alike.

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.

Flexible, hybrid work

Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Azure Cloud Full Stack Application Developer, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around Azure Native services, microservices-based modular designs, and API-driven microservices. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient backend microservices and rich UI applications using SPA or microfrontends.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Scalable Microservices: Design and develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, bounded context of the business domain, and expose functionality via API and event interfaces.
- Build Rich UI Applications: Develop rich UI applications using ReactJS or Angular, with a focus on Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends.
- Implement Event-Driven Architectures: Develop event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and Azure Integration services like Azure Logic apps, Services Bus, Event Grid, and APIM.
- Manage Azure Services: Run and manage services on Azure, including PaaS, content delivery networks, routing services, databases, and storage.
- Implement DevSecOps Practices: Use Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Azure CI to implement continuous integration and delivery, and develop infrastructure as code using Terraform and ARM Templates.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Cloud-Native Development: Experience with cloud-native solutions, including Azure Native services, microservices-based modular designs, and API-driven microservices.
- Full Stack Development: Exposure to developing rich UI applications using SPA or microfrontends, and scalable backend microservices using .NET Core and .Net based development.
- Azure Services Management: Experience with running and managing services on Azure, including PaaS, content delivery networks, routing services, databases, and storage.
- Event-Driven Architecture: Experience with developing event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and Azure Integration services like Azure Logic apps, Services Bus, Event Grid, and APIM.
- DevSecOps Practices: Experience with implementing continuous integration and delivery using Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Azure CI, and developing infrastructure as code using Terraform and ARM Templates.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in Containerization: Exposure to containerized workloads and serverless architectures, with knowledge of Azure Container Service, Azure Container Registry, and Azure Kubernetes Services.

- Experience building modern web applications across backend and frontend technologies
- A passion for clean, maintainable and well-tested code
- Experience working in Agile product development environments
- Strong understanding of software architecture and scalable system design
